# 百洑傳息｜Bioflumen & Xensor Lab

> An interdisciplinary research laboratory at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), Taiwan, led by Dr. Chun-Hao Chang (張鈞豪博士), Assistant Professor. Research focuses on microfluidics, biosensing and in vitro diagnostics.

This is a factual directory of public website content. Updated 2026-10-09. The website presents Traditional Chinese and English together.

## Identity and contact
- Laboratory: 百洑傳息實驗室 / Bioflumen & Xensor Lab
- Principal investigator: 張鈞豪 / Chun-Hao Chang, Assistant Professor
- Department: 醫學生物技術暨檢驗學系 / Department of Biotechnology and Laboratory Science in Medicine
- University: 國立陽明交通大學 / National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
- Email: jimhao@nycu.edu.tw
- Location: Room 223, Biomedical Engineering Building, No. 155, Sec. 2, Li-Nong St., Beitou District, Taipei 112, Taiwan

## Website sections
- [Lab philosophy](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#about): Fluid science, life science and signal technology.
- [Research](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#research): Exhaled breath condensate collection, acoustic microfluidics for sputum liquefaction, centrifugal live-bacteria detection and Au/SiC photocatalytic microfluidics.
- [Principal investigator](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#pi): Education, experience, expertise and official faculty profile.
- [Lab members](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#people): Current member names and roles are listed on the People page.
- [Publications](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#publications): Selected publications with DOI links.
- [Training and joining](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#join): Student training and inquiry information.
- [Questions](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#questions): Research topics, collaboration and joining inquiries.
- [Contact](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#contact): Industry–academia collaboration, research collaboration, joining the lab and student projects. The form requests name, email, organization, inquiry type and message.

## Research context
The four featured research stories describe work completed with the PI's participation before this lab was established. AI-generated conceptual illustrations are labeled on the website. Original paper figures and DOI-linked publications document exact device structures and experimental results.

## Official source
- [NYCU faculty profile](https://dmt.nycu.edu.tw/en/%E5%BC%B5%E9%88%9E%E8%B1%AA%E8%80%81%E5%B8%AB/): Public professional biography and publication list.

## Lab pages
- [Techniques](https://jimhaoch.github.io/techniques.html): Maskless laser microfluidic fabrication, micromilling, FDM/resin 3D printing, aseptic handling, microbial culture and shared cell culture facility.
- [Instruments](https://jimhaoch.github.io/instruments.html): Makera Carvera CNC, bioprinter, inverted and upright microscopes, programmable multichannel syringe pumps, oxygen plasma, resin 3D printing, clean bench, wet bench, and UV laser marking/direct writing.
- [News](https://jimhaoch.github.io/news.html) and [Lab moments](https://jimhaoch.github.io/moments.html): Managed through Pages CMS; empty sections remain blank until entries are added.

## Teaching resources
- [課程講義 / Course materials](https://jimhaoch.github.io/courses.html): Course notes, slides and learning resources organized by academic year and semester. The catalogue is prepared for future uploads.
- [行事曆 / Calendar](https://jimhaoch.github.io/calendar.html): A reserved public schedule page. No calendar is embedded and no events are currently listed.

Industry collaboration: https://jimhaoch.github.io/collaboration.html
Biomedical microfluidic design, CNC and 3D-printed prototypes, wafer-level master molds, fluid handling and control integration. Scope, fees and IP are agreed per project under NYCU procedures.
